g.text: GALINI / L02 / coordinate observation sections
Positive information with explicit floor, sill, head and observer heights / predictions only
W02 / Civic bridge bounded observation
Observer [60.5, 88.6, 8]; opponent [60.5, 59, 4]. Standing eye
crosses the aperture at world Z 9.546; upper crouched eye at 8.916.
Sill 9.10; head 10.10; opaque screen top 10.40.
The selected standing ray lies within the aperture and is
reciprocal; the crouched observer ray lies below the sill. This is
an analytic point-ray prediction, not proof of body visibility,
camera placement, ballistics or safe occupation. The opening is not
traversable.
Purple: standing eye-to-eye. Blue dashed: upper crouched eye. Coordinate planes and wall thickness must survive AML; then capture both stances and the neighboring
cover/guard from both sides.
